remaining_risks: Promoting Stage-2 from hash consistency or green focused tests would bypass the declared upstream state gate.
Existing Stage-1 receipts are time-specific and contain multiple release identities; a later remote state could differ from the recorded readback.
DC2 uses must-match identity semantics, so a future acceptance must bind the final Stage-1 candidate, production readback, evidence time, and independent decision together.
The dirty Harness SSOT worktree is outside this audit scope and was preserved; future Harness validation must account for it independently.
